name: Hoshino Nagisa
source: Childhood friend of [url=/c22452]Komatsu Rina[/url] and [url=/c22455]Sekiya Akito[/url], but due to an incident in the past, she has been distant from [url=/c22455]Sekiya Akito[/url] for several years.
